name: Binary Search
description: Locate a target in a sorted array by repeatedly halving the search range.

name: Breadth-First Search
description: Explore a graph in FIFO order while distinguishing discovery from processing.

name: Depth-First Search
description: Explore graph neighbors recursively while keeping the active path and completed visits distinct.

name: Binary Tree Traversal
description: Visit a complete binary tree in inorder through recursive descent and return.

name: Sliding Window
description: Find the largest sum of a fixed-size contiguous window by adding the entering value and removing the leaving value.

name: Flood Fill
description: Fill a connected region while preserving the complete grid throughout traversal.

name: Maximum Subarray
description: Use Kadane's algorithm to find the largest sum of a contiguous subarray.

name: Topological Sort
description: Produce a deterministic dependency order by processing zero-indegree vertices.

name: Cycle Detection
description: Find the entry to an already-cyclic list with independent slow and fast pointers.

name: Lowest Common Ancestor
description: Find the shared ancestor of two existing tree nodes through recursive returns.

name: Dijkstra's Shortest Path
description: Find shortest paths in a complete weighted graph through distance relaxation.

name: Longest Increasing Subsequence
description: Compare earlier values and keep the best increasing length without changing input bars.

name: Longest Common Subsequence
description: Compare two strings through a single dependency-aware dynamic-programming table.

name: Spiral Matrix
description: Traverse a rectangular grid clockwise by shrinking its four boundaries.

name: Rotate Image
description: Rotate a square matrix clockwise in place by transposing it and reversing each row.

name: Sum of Subsets
description: Search include and exclude branches, explicitly undoing failed choices.

name: N-Queens
description: Place queens on a complete board and explicitly undo conflicting choices.

name: Merge Sort
description: Recursively split the complete array and merge sorted values back into place.

name: Quick Sort
description: Partition the complete array around pivots with stable bar identity through swaps.

name: Boyer-Moore Majority Vote
description: Select a candidate with balanced votes, then verify its majority.
